primary_question: Does strictly pre-decision signed aggressive taker quote-notional contain economically useful information about the immediately following 1-hour Binance USD-M perpetual return after explicit conservative taker friction?

prior_evidence.prior_cost_model: fixed 5/10/20 bps fee stress plus funding; no explicit spread/slippage/taker-fill model

related_but_distinct.JFP01: experiments/research/jigsaw_fast_prospective_signal_discovery_v0/preregistration.json; quarter-hour boundary order imbalance association proposition; no identity link to H010
related_but_distinct.JFP03: experiments/research/jfp03_afi_computability_within_frozen_scope_v0/result.json; absolute hourly taker-flow imbalance for 24-hour realized-volatility value; blocked before scientific outcomes; no identity link to H010

prior_evidence.ancestry_disclosure: Any later result must disclose H010, JFP01, and JFP03 ancestry. This is a material-gap follow-up, not pristine order-flow discovery, a replication of H010, or a rescue of H010.

material_gap_from_h010.feature: raw signed taker quote-notional rather than H010 normalized OFI
material_gap_from_h010.timing: strictly pre-decision source interval with a fixed one-bar embargo
material_gap_from_h010.economics: explicit taker fee and slippage modes with event-time realized funding
material_gap_from_h010.benchmark: flat/cash plus one fixed prior-return continuation opponent
material_gap_from_h010.scope: one continuation proposition only; no reversal, alternate horizon, alternate normalization, or H010 coordinate rerun

mechanism: Persistent aggressive buying or selling may represent information or directional pressure that is not fully incorporated immediately.

source_contract.market_data_source: Binance USD-M Futures 1h kline archive/API contract
source_contract.required_funding_source: realized Binance USD-M funding settlement events with event timestamp and realized rate
source_contract.semantic_admission: The execution-phase source contract must verify that total quote volume is partitioned into taker-buy and taker-sell quote notional so taker_sell_quote_notional = total_quote_volume - taker_buy_quote_volume is valid. If not verified, block; never infer or substitute another field.

universe.selection: Reuse the canonical Breadth V2 fixed 20-identity panel; membership is not changed using new-feature coverage or outcomes.
universe.coverage_rule: Required kline fields, causal normalization history, target prices, and realized funding must be available for a cell; missing cells remain in the denominator and block that scientific cell. No asset deletion, replacement, ranking, or survivorship filtering.

feature_formula.name: SIGNED_TAKER_QUOTE_NOTIONAL_LAGGED_1H
feature_formula.taker_sell_quote_notional: total_quote_volume[t-2] - taker_buy_quote_volume[t-2], only after source semantic admission
feature_formula.normalization: scale[t] = median(total_quote_volume[t-26:t-2]) over exactly 24 prior completed 1h bars, excluding the source bar
feature_formula.position_rule: position[t] = sign(feature[t]); zero is flat only when the signed numerator is exactly zero
feature_formula.degrees_of_freedom: No threshold, lookback tournament, alternate scale, or post-outcome transform is eligible.
feature_formula.material_distinction: This uses raw signed notional, a lagged source bar, and a prior-bar median liquidity scale; it does not algebraically collapse into H010 same-bar normalized OFI or reuse H010's rolling-mean/direction grid.

safe_known_timing.safe_known_after: t-1h plus source publication/closure; execution admission must verify the completed source bar
safe_known_timing.decision_time: t at the target bar open, after the fixed one-bar embargo
safe_known_timing.no_overlap_rule: No unfinished bar, same-period source, close[t] decision, or source-to-target overlap is permitted.
safe_known_timing.delay_selection: The one-bar embargo is frozen structurally before any V0 outcome and cannot be changed after outcome access.

prediction_horizon.return_definition: open[t+1h] / open[t] - 1 for the target bar's taker-executable open-to-open path

diagnostic_only_controls.purpose: Test whether V0 adds incremental utility beyond the simplest prior-return continuation rule.
diagnostic_only_controls.optimization: None; one fixed prior 1h return only.

simple_opponents.control_policy: Controls diagnose incremental utility and cannot rescue, replace, or create an alternate V0 candidate.

execution_contract.semantics: Conservative taker execution; no maker, queue, rebate, or free-close assumption.
execution_contract.entry_price: Target-bar open plus the declared slippage cost; position is eligible only at target-bar open.
execution_contract.exit_price: Following-bar open plus the declared slippage cost; no terminal close fill.
execution_contract.turnover: absolute position change per one-way transition; a direct long/short flip is two turnover units
execution_contract.cost_timing: fee and slippage are charged at each transition using the same turnover convention as canonical QntyLab accounting
execution_contract.funding_treatment: Realized event-time funding is charged or credited only when the position is open at the settlement event; no forward-fill or zero-fill
execution_contract.implementation_boundary: Existing qntylab.bar_path is close-to-close and cannot honestly implement this open-to-open entry/exit contract without a separately authorized adapter. This preregistration adds no executor; an execution phase must either prove compatibility or remain blocked.

cost_modes.policy: Both modes are fixed before outcomes; no 5/10/20 bps search and no cost rescue is permitted.

temporal_design.excluded_interval: 2023 is not promoted to a fresh holdout; the canonical Breadth V2 fixed development partition is reused.
temporal_design.later_confirmation: A sealed or prospective confirmation requires a separate preregistration and authorization.

search_denominator.new_v0_primary_denominator: 1 mechanism × 1 feature formula × 1 normalization × 1 direction × 1 horizon × 1 universe × 2 cost modes × 20 fixed assets = 40 asset-cost cells, with 3 fixed chronological diagnostics
search_denominator.prior_h010_denominator_binding: H010 remains 6 variants × 3 assets = 18 prior asset-variant rows and is not erased or pooled as new V0 evidence.

economic_survivor_gate.all_required_cells: Every required asset-cost-period cell must be valid; any missing source, funding, timing, semantic, or integrity cell blocks V0 and cannot be deleted.
economic_survivor_gate.aggregate_economics: Aggregate net return is positive under BASELINE and STRESS, and aggregate benchmark excess versus FLAT_CASH is positive under STRESS.
economic_survivor_gate.incremental_utility: Aggregate STRESS excess versus PRIOR_1H_RETURN_CONTINUATION is positive; the prior-return control is fixed and is not an eligible V0 variant.
economic_survivor_gate.asset_breadth: At least 10 of 20 assets have positive STRESS net return and positive STRESS excess versus the fixed prior-return control.
economic_survivor_gate.temporal_breadth: At least 2 of 3 fixed chronological blocks have positive STRESS net return and positive STRESS excess versus the fixed prior-return control.
economic_survivor_gate.concentration: No single asset contributes more than 35% of the sum of positive STRESS incremental-excess contributions, and no single block contributes more than 65% of that sum.
economic_survivor_gate.stress_retention: STRESS incremental excess is at least 50% of positive BASELINE incremental excess.
economic_survivor_gate.integrity: No unresolved timing, source-semantic, funding, coverage, execution, denominator, or authority failure remains.
economic_survivor_gate.interpretation: A positive aggregate net return alone is insufficient; failure of any gate kills V0 for this frozen proposition.

cheap_kill_rule: If the single frozen signed-flow proposition cannot produce broad, temporally credible, cost-adjusted incremental economic utility under the conservative execution contract, KILL V0. Failure authorizes no alternate normalization, reversal, horizon, threshold, universe, or execution assumption.
multiplicity_treatment: The low-dimensional denominator is preserved explicitly. No formal p-value or generic statistical infrastructure is authorized in this phase. Any later family-appropriate selection adjustment must use the frozen denominator and cannot rescue a gate failure.
missing_data_rules: Preserve every ordered asset and period in the denominator. Missing required kline, normalization history, target price, or realized funding coverage blocks the affected cell; do not zero-fill, forward-fill, backfill, substitute assets, or inspect outcomes to choose exclusions.

qntyagenteval_applicability.lookup_scope: Committed QntyLab repository search for QntyAgentEval/qnty_agent_eval/evaluator contracts.
qntyagenteval_applicability.action: Do not build one; this preregistration is outcome-blind and principally a research contract.

hostile_review_policy.review_scope: One independent hostile review covering H010 duplication, material distinction, direction selection, timing, source semantics, execution, costs, funding, universe, denominator, benchmarks, multiplicity, and rescue pathways.
hostile_review_policy.targeted_rereview: At most one targeted re-review only if a Critical or High finding requires repair.

strict_stop: This artifact authorizes no scientific execution and stops after contract review and canonical Git verification.
